title: Unit embed banner
description: A wide, softly rounded card whose pale tint fades to white toward the right: a two-line heading, a grey sentence and a black pill on the left, and an empty screenshot frame with a cyan hairline bleeding off the right and bottom edges under a round cyan glow. On phones the frame drops below the text, inset from the left.
notes: media slot: a product screenshot (630×400) cropped by the card's right and bottom edges; the glow behind it stands in for the original's animated canvas
the glow uses the glow token
